criteria.requirement: Fix actual Table.update_many ensure/types handling before compiling SQL. Validate every input match key and positive non-bool chunk_size before any schema/DML change, synchronize the union with explicit type overrides, retain ensure=False column-dropping semantics and make empty input a no-op. Group rows by present update fields rather than padding absent fields to NULL; safe generated key binds cannot collide with real column names. Preserve existing literals, chunk commits and row inputs; empty/duplicate matching keys fail. Demonstrate real SQLite schema/type and row state, including a late missing key causing no earlier DML/DDL.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
